dlinks.acquisition: Finish a Command Board game from the menu in which either the "Captain Justice" or "Captain Dark" special events are activated

dlink_progression: Defeat enemies while linked and collect that link’s emblem. The first and second emblems raise the link to levels 1 and 2, expanding its deck and granting the listed abilities; level 2 also unlocks an enhanced finisher. Later emblems refill the gauge. Per-link drop percentages and every temporary deck/finisher are not yet indexed.
exclusions: Vanitas: temporary final battle D-Link, not ordinary persistent acquisition
